Passion For The Perfect Taste

Peking Garden Restaurant

Welcome to Peking Garden  Restaurant. Located at 2316 St Stephens Rd, Mobile, AL 36617, our  restaurant is a hidden gem in the heart of Mobile Circle Square.Our restaurant‘s story is one of passion, tradition, and a love for bringing people together through exceptional  food. For generations, our dedicated itself to perfecting the art of cooking, blending the timeless elegance of Chinese cuisine with the bold, hearty flavors of American dishes. It all comes together in a warm and inviting setting that feels just like home. At our restaurant, we take pride in offering a diverse menu that caters to every palate. From exquisite sushi rolls that artfully combine flavors and textures to soul-warming ramen that warms you from the inside out, We believe that a meal is more than just sustenance; it‘s a chance to connect, share stories, and create cherished memories. Our restaurant is built on the values of community and family. We consider every guest who walks through our doors as an extension of our family, and we treat them as such. We take pride in serving not only delicious food but also warm hospitality that makes you feel right at home.Chinese Cuisine

Customers Say

Review

“ Hungry on my way home after a full day of walking through the streets of Mobile, I stumbled over this place. It was packed with people, but I did not have to wait Long. The Staff was very friendly and the food excellent. The vegetables were crispy and perfectly cooked, the sauce delicious and tasty. I hope I’ll find this place again. ”
Geographic Reference

Petter

“ Me and my bestie enjoyed the food so much!!! They have very big servings with just the best price. and the taste is just delish!!! Polite staffs too!Did a take out order of Chicken Lo Mein and asked for it to be spicy. This might be the best Chinese food I’ve had. The spice was perfectly added and pretty sure it unlocked some past memories. ”

Holton

“ This is the best Chinese for me after about two years haven’t went to a real Chinese restaurant. It was a short travel in NYC with my family. As a Chinese, the taste of the food are really decent. The price for the location is very reasonable. The servers are awesome, I wish my coworkers can as good as they are lol ”
